title: Treasure Hunt
statementMd:
Captain Bill the Hummingbird and his crew recieved an interesting challenge offer. Some stranger gave them a map, potion of teleportation and said that only this potion might help them to reach the treasure.

Bottle with potion has two values $*x*$ and $*y*$ written on it. These values define four moves which can be performed using the potion:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca0e2ade7d6ceea673d731c6dc116c814776df94.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58e9516054e46ba5c263ff97be1d42c210432a50.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d3a36e5eb47a11f1a47d9b6889e22202c5ac602f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c60349e088498550b4b6728417a78afecd913356.png)

Map shows that the position of Captain Bill the Hummingbird is $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and the position of the treasure is $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$.

You task is to tell Captain Bill the Hummingbird whether he should accept this challenge or decline. If it is possible for Captain to reach the treasure using the potion then output `"YES"`, otherwise `"NO"` (without quotes).

**The potion can be used infinite amount of times.**

## Input

The first line contains four integer numbers $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$ ($- 10^{5} ≤ *x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{5}$) — positions of Captain Bill the Hummingbird and treasure respectively.

The second line contains two integer numbers $*x*, *y*$ ($1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ 10^{5}$) — values on the potion bottle.

## Output

Print `"YES"` if it is possible for Captain to reach the treasure using the potion, otherwise print `"NO"` (without quotes).

## Note

In the first example there exists such sequence of moves:

1. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7c939890fb4ed35688177327dac981bfa9216c00.png) — the first type of move
2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/afbfa42fbac4e0641e7466e3aac74cbbb08ed597.png) — the third type of move
statementZhMd:
Hummingbird 船长 Bill 和他的船员收到了一份有趣的挑战邀请。一位陌生人给了他们一张地图和一瓶传送药水，并说只有这瓶药水才能帮助他们找到宝藏。

药水瓶上写着两个值 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$。这些值决定了使用药水时可以执行的四种移动：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ca0e2ade7d6ceea673d731c6dc116c814776df94.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58e9516054e46ba5c263ff97be1d42c210432a50.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d3a36e5eb47a11f1a47d9b6889e22202c5ac602f.png)
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c60349e088498550b4b6728417a78afecd913356.png)

地图显示，Hummingbird 船长 Bill 的位置是 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$，宝藏的位置是 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$。

你的任务是告诉 Hummingbird 船长 Bill 是否应该接受这个挑战。如果船长可以使用药水到达宝藏，则输出 `"YES"`，否则输出 `"NO"`（不含引号）。

**药水可以使用无限次。**

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$（$- 10^{5} ≤ *x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示 Hummingbird 船长 Bill 和宝藏的位置。

第二行包含两个整数 $*x*, *y*$（$1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示药水瓶上的数值。

## 输出格式

如果船长可以使用药水到达宝藏，则输出 `"YES"`，否则输出 `"NO"`（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，存在如下移动序列：

1. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7c939890fb4ed35688177327dac981bfa9216c00.png) — 第一种移动
2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/afbfa42fbac4e0641e7466e3aac74cbbb08ed597.png) — 第三种移动
